points.why: It refuses to pick which group was right and says not to announce a diagnosis up front, but it never says the groups disagree on what the problem is, and it seeds its own date-driven chain.
It builds a records-based timeline of undisputed facts and holds a joint blameless session where every group's claim goes on before any cause, aiming for shared agreement on the loop.
It checks the last 4–6 launches for a pattern and writes explicit event, pattern, structure and belief sentences, including a fixed-date belief.
It puts structural fixes first in the readout, but it never records which groups were consulted versus only informed, and it treats the structural question as answerable by Friday.

pitfalls.why: It treats the vendor API test as one link and calls fixing it alone an event-level fix.

notes: Its upfront hypothesis that the fixed date drove the chain leans toward product's framing, though it is labeled a guess to be tested against the timeline.
